candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout; the fault originates in the order service, not the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics are absent, so the internal cause of the 500 (e.g. db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout) is not established; only the failing hop is bounded.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway POST /v1/checkout returning 502 because the downstream order service returns 500 on POST /v1/orders; topology confirms gateway->order. The bounded root cause is an order-service HTTP 500, but the specific internal failure mode is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service logs and metrics for POST /v1/orders to identify the internal 500 cause
Dependency metrics for order->inventory, order->payment, order->postgresql to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout
